#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script> -- [snakemake targets/options]

# Slurm resources:
#   --job-name=controljob_%j
#   --output=snakemake_%j.log
#   --partition=vcpu,hpcpu
#   --time=24:00:00
#   -c 1
#   --mem 2000

#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 1
#flux: --time-limit=24h

# Omitted Slurm option: --mem 2000
# Flux memory requests are site/config dependent and not universally portable.
# Performance implication: job may be scheduled on nodes with insufficient memory, risking OOM kills or degraded performance.

# Omitted Slurm option: --partition=vcpu,hpcpu
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may run on different hardware or with different limits/priority (or be rejected by policy).

# Omitted Slurm option: --job-name=controljob_%j
# Slurm's %j token (job id) is not portable in Flux --job-name.
# Performance implication: none, but job identification may be less informative.

# Omitted Slurm option: --output=snakemake_%j.log
# Slurm's %j token (job id) is not portable in Flux output directives.
# Performance implication: none, but logs may overwrite/collide unless you choose a unique filename.

SNAKEMAKE_ENV=snakemake

# Initialize conda:
eval "$(conda shell.bash hook)"
conda activate "${SNAKEMAKE_ENV}"

# The Snakemake profile `./slurm` is Slurm-specific.
# Omitted: --profile ./slurm
# Performance implication: rules will not be submitted as Slurm jobs; configure a Flux-native Snakemake executor/profile for distributed execution.

snakemake --snakefile workflow/Snakefile \
          --configfile config/config.yaml \
          --rerun-triggers mtime \
          --directory "${PWD}" \
          "${@}"

reasons: The original Slurm job requested memory (`--mem 2000`) but the Flux resource section has no memory request; on systems that schedule/enforce memory this can under-provision the job and risk OOM or degraded performance.

The original Slurm job specified partitions (`--partition=vcpu,hpcpu`) but the Flux resource section has no queue/partition selection; on sites where this affects eligibility/limits, scheduling behavior may differ or the job may be rejected.
